headline: Signal flat (0); live sample still tiny (7 resolved trades) and net negative, but dominated by 1-2 outliers; BTC ~$63.5k
regime_note: No live exposure right now (signal=0). This remains a marginal mean-reversion fade whose ~4 bps expected gross edge is dwarfed by per-trade swings, so a handful of losers can't yet be distinguished from random variation.
assessment_md:
**How it's doing:** No position on right now (signal=0), BTC ~$63,505. The strategy trades rarely by design, so evidence accumulates slowly.

**The numbers:** The resolved ledger shows 7 trades, only 1 winner (14%), averaging -17.2 bps and -120.2 bps total. The broader rolling window of 15 bets is milder: 67% win rate, gross +0.43 bps, net -2.57 bps after 3 bps costs. Two trades do most of the damage — a -60.9 bps loss on 2026-07-31 and -22.8 bps on 07-17.

**What changed vs last time:** Very little. Still 7 resolved trades; signal still flat. The picture is essentially unchanged from the prior 'none' read.

**What this does and doesn't tell us:** 7 trades is far too few to judge an edge this small — expected gross is only ~4 bps/bet, while single trades swing ±50+ bps. The losing streak *looks* ugly, but it's well inside what noise can produce at this sample size, and a couple of outliers drive the mean. Note also: the independent edge-search found **zero** survivors that beat 5 bps cost on both venues — a real caution flag about net profitability.

**Bottom line:** Too thin to conclude anything, and consistent with a marginal-to-unprofitable strategy. No panic, no exposure now — but this is not showing profit, and I'd move to 'watch' if net stays clearly negative over a few dozen trades.
